decisions: KEGG C01172 and neutral CHEBI17719 have identical full Standard InChI. CHEBI58247 preserves that beta stereochemistry after explicit phosphate deprotonation; it is not exact protonation identity to the neutral KEGG compound.

Rhea15842 substrate CHEBI61548 leaves the anomer unspecified. It cannot be asserted as an exact stereochemical equivalent to the KEGG beta-specific substrate or used as sole evidence for that specificity.

R10907 also has beta-specific C01172 and changes the nicotinamide cofactor to NAD. It does not resolve the generic-versus-beta mapping question and must not introduce NAD use into the selected E. coli NADP route without separate support.

R00835 is the separate generic NADP activity in KEGG, with C00092. KEGG lists R02736 as a narrower case in its reaction hierarchy. Keeping a native beta-specific R02736 step with explicitly source-scoped evidence is a possible complete M00008 representation; later independent adjudication must choose the final chemistry and enzyme assertion scope.
CHEBI58225 is the alpha anomer and is explicitly rejected as a beta identity.

issuing_database_observation.prior_hash_scope: The source database was fully hashed in prior Pyochelin acceptance and integrated replay. This bounded ED check newly queries selected issued structures; a later formal ED source replay must bind its actual whole database hash.

limits: No new pathway record or canonical scientific approval.
No exclusive E. coli anomer specificity inferred from structure comparison alone.
No exact equivalence of neutral and deprotonated forms, specific and generic anomers, or NADP and NAD activity.
